Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Dunford Modern Kitchen Dining Chair, 33 Inch Height, Ivory
Colors: Ivory
Materials: Wood
This gorgeous ivory dining chair is a modern twist on the classic wingback design. The plush curves and bold angles offer stylish comfort with a contemporary flair. Solid wood frame with brass metal leg Curved base for additional support without stretchers Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. 24"D x 24"W x 33"H Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
